sql: SELECT h.facility_name, h.county, h.hospital_ownership, h.overall_rating AS overall_star_rating, latest.score AS pneumonia_30_day_readmission_rate FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT mv.score FROM hq.measure_values AS mv WHERE mv.facility_id = h.facility_id AND mv.measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' ORDER BY mv.period_end DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS latest ON TRUE WHERE h.is_houston_area = TRUE ORDER BY latest.score ASC, h.facility_name LIMIT 200

WITH texas_total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_hospitals FROM hq.hospitals WHERE is_texas = TRUE), latest AS (SELECT mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id, mv.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id ORDER BY mv.period_end DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM hq.measure_values AS mv JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = mv.facility_id WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE), scored AS (SELECT measure_id, COUNT(*) AS hospitals_with_score FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY measure_id) SELECT m.measure_id, m.domain, m.measure_name, COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0) AS hospitals_with_score, t.total_hospitals AS total_texas_hospitals, ROUND(100.0 * (t.total_hospitals - COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0)) / NULLIF(t.total_hospitals, 0), 2) AS percent_missing FROM hq.measures AS m CROSS JOIN texas_total AS t LEFT JOIN scored AS s ON s.measure_id = m.measure_id WHERE COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0) < t.total_hospitals / 2.0 ORDER BY percent_missing DESC, m.measure_id LIMIT 200

SELECT h.hospital_ownership AS ownership_type, COUNT(DISTINCT h.facility_id) AS hospital_count, AVG(hc.top_box_pct) AS avg_would_definitely_recommend_pct, AVG(CAST(h.overall_rating AS DECIMAL)) AS avg_overall_star_rating FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN hq.v_hcahps AS hc ON hc.facility_id = h.facility_id AND hc.measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY' WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE GROUP BY h.hospital_ownership HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT h.facility_id) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_would_definitely_recommend_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

SELECT county, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY score ASC) AS rank, facility_name AS hospital, score AS heart_failure_30_day_readmission_rate FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE is_houston_area = TRUE AND measure_id = 'READM_30_HF' AND score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY county, rank, hospital LIMIT 200

SELECT facility_name, county, score, AVG(score) OVER () AS texas_average, score - AVG(score) OVER () AS difference_from_texas_average, AVG(score) OVER (PARTITION BY county) AS county_average FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' ORDER BY difference_from_texas_average ASC, facility_name LIMIT 200

WITH national AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, is_houston_area, score, national_pct_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score ASC) AS national_rank FROM hq.v_benchmarks WHERE measure_id = 'MORT_30_HF' AND score IS NOT NULL) SELECT facility_name, score AS mortality_rate, national_pct_rank, national_rank FROM national WHERE is_houston_area ORDER BY national_pct_rank ASC, national_rank ASC LIMIT 200

WITH periods AS (
  SELECT
    h.facility_name,
    mv.facility_id,
    mv.period_end,
    mv.score,
    LAG(mv.score) OVER (
      PARTITION BY mv.facility_id
      ORDER BY mv.period_end
    ) AS prior_score,
    LAG(mv.period_end) OVER (
      PARTITION BY mv.facility_id
      ORDER BY mv.period_end
    ) AS prior_period_end,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY mv.facility_id
      ORDER BY mv.period_end DESC
    ) AS latest_rank
  FROM hq.measure_values AS mv
  JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = mv.facility_id
  WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE
    AND mv.measure_id = 'H_HSP_RATING_9_10'
    AND mv.score IS NOT NULL
    AND mv.period_end IS NOT NULL
), changes AS (
  SELECT
    facility_name,
    prior_period_end,
    period_end AS latest_period_end,
    prior_score,
    score AS latest_score,
    score - prior_score AS change_pp
  FROM periods
  WHERE latest_rank = 1
    AND prior_score IS NOT NULL
    AND score <> prior_score
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN change_pp > 0 THEN 'Improvement' ELSE 'Decline' END AS change_type,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY CASE WHEN change_pp > 0 THEN 'Improvement' ELSE 'Decline' END
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN change_pp > 0 THEN change_pp END DESC,
               CASE WHEN change_pp < 0 THEN change_pp END ASC,
               facility_name
    ) AS rank_within_type,
    facility_name,
    prior_period_end,
    latest_period_end,
    prior_score,
    latest_score,
    change_pp
  FROM changes
)
SELECT
  change_type,
  rank_within_type,
  facility_name,
  prior_period_end,
  latest_period_end,
  prior_score,
  latest_score,
  change_pp
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_within_type <= 10
ORDER BY CASE change_type WHEN 'Improvement' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
         rank_within_type

WITH raw AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, measure_id, score FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'H_RECMND_DY', 'SEP_1') AND score IS NOT NULL), stats AS (SELECT measure_id, AVG(score) AS mean_score, STDDEV_POP(score) AS sd_score FROM raw GROUP BY measure_id), standardized AS (SELECT r.facility_id, r.facility_name, r.measure_id, CASE WHEN r.measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' THEN (s.mean_score - r.score) / NULLIF(s.sd_score, 0) ELSE (r.score - s.mean_score) / NULLIF(s.sd_score, 0) END AS z_score FROM raw AS r JOIN stats AS s USING (measure_id)), hospital_scores AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, MAX(z_score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS pneumonia_readmission_z, MAX(z_score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS definitely_recommend_z, MAX(z_score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'SEP_1') AS sepsis_bundle_z FROM standardized GROUP BY facility_id, facility_name), composites AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, pneumonia_readmission_z, definitely_recommend_z, sepsis_bundle_z, (pneumonia_readmission_z + definitely_recommend_z + sepsis_bundle_z) / 3.0 AS composite_z FROM hospital_scores WHERE pneumonia_readmission_z IS NOT NULL AND definitely_recommend_z IS NOT NULL AND sepsis_bundle_z IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite_z DESC, facility_name) AS top_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite_z ASC, facility_name) AS bottom_rank FROM composites), selected AS (SELECT CAST('Top 10' AS TEXT) AS group_label, top_rank AS rank, facility_name, pneumonia_readmission_z, definitely_recommend_z, sepsis_bundle_z, composite_z, 1 AS group_order FROM ranked WHERE top_rank <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT CAST('Bottom 10' AS TEXT) AS group_label, bottom_rank AS rank, facility_name, pneumonia_readmission_z, definitely_recommend_z, sepsis_bundle_z, composite_z, 2 AS group_order FROM ranked WHERE bottom_rank <= 10) SELECT group_label, rank, facility_name, pneumonia_readmission_z, definitely_recommend_z, sepsis_bundle_z, composite_z FROM selected ORDER BY group_order, rank LIMIT 200

WITH readmission AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, county, score AS readmission_score FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' AND score IS NOT NULL), recommendation AS (SELECT facility_id, score AS recommend_score FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY' AND score IS NOT NULL), texas_averages AS (SELECT (SELECT AVG(score) FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' AND score IS NOT NULL) AS readmission_average, (SELECT AVG(score) FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY' AND score IS NOT NULL) AS recommend_average) SELECT r.facility_name AS hospital, r.county, r.readmission_score, a.readmission_average, p.recommend_score, a.recommend_average FROM readmission AS r JOIN recommendation AS p ON p.facility_id = r.facility_id CROSS JOIN texas_averages AS a WHERE r.readmission_score < a.readmission_average AND p.recommend_score < a.recommend_average ORDER BY r.facility_name LIMIT 200

SELECT h.county, COUNT(h.facility_id) AS hospital_count, COUNT(v.score) AS hospitals_with_readmission_score, AVG(v.score) AS mean_readmission_score, SUM(v.score * v.denominator) / NULLIF(SUM(v.denominator), 0) AS denominator_weighted_mean_readmission_score FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN hq.v_tx_latest AS v ON v.facility_id = h.facility_id AND v.measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE GROUP BY h.county ORDER BY denominator_weighted_mean_readmission_score ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT facility_name, readm_pn_pct AS pneumonia_readmission_rate, mort_hf_pct AS heart_failure_mortality_rate, hai_clabsi_sir AS central_line_infection_ratio, sepsis_bundle_pct AS sepsis_care_bundle_percentage, recommend_pct AS would_recommend_percentage, hcahps_star AS hcahps_summary_star_rating FROM hq.v_scorecard WHERE is_houston_area = TRUE ORDER BY recommend_pct DESC NULLS LAST, facility_name LIMIT 200

SELECT measure_name AS measure, COUNT(*) AS texas_hospitals, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE (higher_is_better AND score > national_avg) OR (NOT higher_is_better AND score < national_avg)) AS texas_hospitals_beating_national, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE (higher_is_better AND score > national_avg) OR (NOT higher_is_better AND score < national_avg)) / COUNT(*) AS share_beating_national_pct FROM hq.v_benchmarks WHERE is_texas IS TRUE AND measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'MORT_30_HF', 'HAI_1_SIR', 'SEP_1', 'H_RECMND_DY', 'H_STAR_RATING') AND score IS NOT NULL AND national_avg IS NOT NULL AND higher_is_better IS NOT NULL GROUP BY measure_id, measure_name ORDER BY measure_name LIMIT 200

SELECT h.facility_name, h.county, h.hospital_ownership, h.overall_rating, v.score AS pneumonia_30_day_readmission_rate FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN hq.v_tx_latest AS v ON v.facility_id = h.facility_id AND v.measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' WHERE h.is_houston_area = TRUE ORDER BY v.score ASC LIMIT 200

WITH texas AS (SELECT h.facility_id FROM hq.hospitals AS h WHERE h.is_texas), total_texas AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_hospitals FROM texas), latest AS (SELECT mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id, mv.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id ORDER BY mv.period_end DESC NULLS LAST, mv.id DESC) AS rn FROM hq.measure_values AS mv JOIN texas AS t ON t.facility_id = mv.facility_id), scored AS (SELECT l.measure_id, COUNT(*) AS hospitals_with_score FROM latest AS l WHERE l.rn = 1 AND l.score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.measure_id) SELECT m.measure_id, m.domain, m.measure_name, COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0) AS hospitals_with_score, tt.total_hospitals AS total_texas_hospitals, ROUND((CAST((tt.total_hospitals - COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0)) AS DECIMAL) / tt.total_hospitals) * 100, 2) AS percent_missing FROM hq.measures AS m CROSS JOIN total_texas AS tt LEFT JOIN scored AS s ON s.measure_id = m.measure_id WHERE COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0) < tt.total_hospitals / 2.0 ORDER BY percent_missing DESC, m.measure_id LIMIT 200

SELECT h.hospital_ownership, ROUND(CAST(AVG(c.top_box_pct) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_would_definitely_recommend_pct, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.overall_rating) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_overall_star_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT h.facility_id) AS hospital_count FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN hq.v_hcahps AS c ON c.facility_id = h.facility_id AND c.measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY' WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE GROUP BY h.hospital_ownership HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT h.facility_id) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_would_definitely_recommend_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

SELECT county, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY score ASC) AS rank, facility_name AS hospital, score AS rate FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE is_houston_area = TRUE AND measure_id = 'READM_30_HF' AND score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY county, rank, hospital LIMIT 200

WITH pneumonia AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, county, measure_id, measure_name, score FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN'), texas_average AS (SELECT AVG(score) AS tx_avg FROM pneumonia), county_averages AS (SELECT county, AVG(score) AS county_avg FROM pneumonia GROUP BY county) SELECT p.facility_id, p.facility_name, p.county, p.measure_id, p.measure_name, p.score, ROUND(t.tx_avg, 2) AS texas_average, ROUND(CAST((p.score - t.tx_avg) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS difference_from_texas_average, ROUND(c.county_avg, 2) AS county_average FROM pneumonia AS p CROSS JOIN texas_average AS t JOIN county_averages AS c ON c.county = p.county ORDER BY difference_from_texas_average ASC, p.facility_name LIMIT 200

WITH ranked_periods AS (SELECT h.facility_name, mv.measure_id, mv.measure_name, mv.period_end, mv.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id ORDER BY mv.period_end DESC) AS period_rank FROM hq.measure_values AS mv JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = mv.facility_id WHERE h.is_texas AND mv.measure_id = 'H_HSP_RATING_9_10' AND mv.score IS NOT NULL), changes AS (SELECT facility_name, measure_id, measure_name, MAX(period_end) FILTER(WHERE period_rank = 1) AS current_period_end, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE period_rank = 1) AS current_score, MAX(period_end) FILTER(WHERE period_rank = 2) AS prior_period_end, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE period_rank = 2) AS prior_score FROM ranked_periods WHERE period_rank <= 2 GROUP BY facility_name, measure_id, measure_name HAVING COUNT(*) = 2), ranked_changes AS (SELECT *, current_score - prior_score AS change, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY current_score - prior_score DESC, facility_name) AS improvement_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY current_score - prior_score ASC, facility_name) AS decline_rank FROM changes) SELECT 'Biggest improvement' AS change_group, improvement_rank AS rank, facility_name, measure_id, measure_name, prior_period_end, prior_score, current_period_end, current_score, ROUND(CAST(change AS DECIMAL), 2) AS change_percentage_points FROM ranked_changes WHERE improvement_rank <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'Biggest decline' AS change_group, decline_rank AS rank, facility_name, measure_id, measure_name, prior_period_end, prior_score, current_period_end, current_score, ROUND(CAST(change AS DECIMAL), 2) AS change_percentage_points FROM ranked_changes WHERE decline_rank <= 10 ORDER BY change_group, rank LIMIT 200

WITH hospital_scores AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS pneumonia_readmission_rate, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS definitely_recommend_pct, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'SEP_1') AS sepsis_care_bundle_pct FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'H_RECMND_DY', 'SEP_1') AND score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY facility_id, facility_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT measure_id) = 3), stats AS (SELECT AVG(pneumonia_readmission_rate) AS readm_avg, STDDEV(pneumonia_readmission_rate) AS readm_sd, AVG(definitely_recommend_pct) AS recommend_avg, STDDEV(definitely_recommend_pct) AS recommend_sd, AVG(sepsis_care_bundle_pct) AS sepsis_avg, STDDEV(sepsis_care_bundle_pct) AS sepsis_sd FROM hospital_scores), standardized AS (SELECT h.facility_name, -((h.pneumonia_readmission_rate - s.readm_avg) / NULLIF(s.readm_sd, 0)) AS pneumonia_readmission_z, (h.definitely_recommend_pct - s.recommend_avg) / NULLIF(s.recommend_sd, 0) AS definitely_recommend_z, (h.sepsis_care_bundle_pct - s.sepsis_avg) / NULLIF(s.sepsis_sd, 0) AS sepsis_care_bundle_z FROM hospital_scores AS h CROSS JOIN stats AS s), composites AS (SELECT facility_name, pneumonia_readmission_z, definitely_recommend_z, sepsis_care_bundle_z, (pneumonia_readmission_z + definitely_recommend_z + sepsis_care_bundle_z) / 3.0 AS composite_score FROM standardized), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite_score DESC, facility_name) AS top_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite_score ASC, facility_name) AS bottom_rank FROM composites), results AS (SELECT 1 AS group_order, 'Top 10' AS group_name, top_rank AS rank, facility_name, composite_score, pneumonia_readmission_z, definitely_recommend_z, sepsis_care_bundle_z FROM ranked WHERE top_rank <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS group_order, 'Bottom 10' AS group_name, bottom_rank AS rank, facility_name, composite_score, pneumonia_readmission_z, definitely_recommend_z, sepsis_care_bundle_z FROM ranked WHERE bottom_rank <= 10) SELECT group_name, rank, facility_name, ROUND(CAST(composite_score AS DECIMAL), 2) AS composite_score, ROUND(CAST(pneumonia_readmission_z AS DECIMAL), 2) AS pneumonia_readmission_z, ROUND(CAST(definitely_recommend_z AS DECIMAL), 2) AS definitely_recommend_z, ROUND(CAST(sepsis_care_bundle_z AS DECIMAL), 2) AS sepsis_care_bundle_z FROM results ORDER BY group_order, rank LIMIT 200

WITH hospital_scores AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, county, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS readmission_rate, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS recommend_definitely_pct FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'H_RECMND_DY') GROUP BY facility_id, facility_name, county), texas_averages AS (SELECT AVG(readmission_rate) AS avg_readmission_rate, AVG(recommend_definitely_pct) AS avg_recommend_definitely_pct FROM hospital_scores) SELECT hs.facility_name AS hospital, hs.county, 'READM_30_PN' AS readmission_measure_id, 'Pneumonia (PN) 30-Day Readmission Rate' AS readmission_measure_name, hs.readmission_rate, ta.avg_readmission_rate, 'H_RECMND_DY' AS recommendation_measure_id, 'Patients who reported YES, they would definitely recommend the hospital' AS recommendation_measure_name, hs.recommend_definitely_pct, ta.avg_recommend_definitely_pct FROM hospital_scores AS hs CROSS JOIN texas_averages AS ta WHERE hs.readmission_rate < ta.avg_readmission_rate AND hs.recommend_definitely_pct < ta.avg_recommend_definitely_pct ORDER BY hs.facility_name LIMIT 200

SELECT h.county, 'READM_30_PN' AS measure_id, 'Pneumonia (PN) 30-Day Readmission Rate' AS measure_name, COUNT(DISTINCT h.facility_id) AS hospital_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.score IS NOT NULL THEN h.facility_id END) AS hospitals_with_score, ROUND(CAST(AVG(t.score) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS simple_mean_readmission_score, ROUND(CAST((SUM(t.score * t.denominator) / NULLIF(SUM(t.denominator), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS denominator_weighted_mean_readmission_score FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN hq.v_tx_latest AS t ON t.facility_id = h.facility_id AND t.measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' WHERE h.is_texas IS TRUE GROUP BY h.county ORDER BY denominator_weighted_mean_readmission_score ASC, h.county LIMIT 200

SELECT facility_name, city, readm_pn_pct AS pneumonia_readmission_rate, mort_hf_pct AS heart_failure_mortality_rate, hai_clabsi_sir AS central_line_infection_ratio, sepsis_bundle_pct AS sepsis_care_bundle_percentage, recommend_pct AS would_recommend_percentage, hcahps_star AS hcahps_summary_star_rating FROM hq.v_scorecard WHERE is_houston_area IS TRUE ORDER BY recommend_pct DESC NULLS LAST, facility_name LIMIT 200

SELECT measure_id, measure_name, COUNT(DISTINCT facility_id) FILTER(WHERE is_texas) AS texas_hospitals, COUNT(DISTINCT facility_id) FILTER(WHERE is_texas AND national_avg IS NOT NULL AND higher_is_better IS NOT NULL AND ((higher_is_better AND score > national_avg) OR (NOT higher_is_better AND score < national_avg))) AS beating_national, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT facility_id) FILTER(WHERE is_texas AND national_avg IS NOT NULL AND higher_is_better IS NOT NULL AND ((higher_is_better AND score > national_avg) OR (NOT higher_is_better AND score < national_avg))) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT facility_id) FILTER(WHERE is_texas AND national_avg IS NOT NULL AND higher_is_better IS NOT NULL), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS share_beating_national_pct FROM hq.v_benchmarks WHERE measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'MORT_30_HF', 'HAI_1_SIR', 'SEP_1', 'H_RECMND_DY', 'H_STAR_RATING') AND score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY measure_id, measure_name ORDER BY measure_id LIMIT 200

WITH latest_pneumonia_readmission AS (SELECT facility_id, score FROM (SELECT mv.facility_id, mv.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mv.facility_id ORDER BY mv.period_end DESC NULLS LAST, mv.period_start DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM hq.measure_values AS mv WHERE mv.measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) SELECT h.facility_name, h.county, h.hospital_ownership, h.overall_rating, l.score AS pneumonia_30_day_readmission_rate FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN latest_pneumonia_readmission AS l ON l.facility_id = h.facility_id WHERE h.is_houston_area = TRUE ORDER BY l.score ASC, h.facility_name ASC LIMIT 200

WITH tx_hospitals AS (SELECT facility_id FROM hq.hospitals WHERE is_texas), total_tx AS (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS total_hospitals FROM tx_hospitals), ranked_values AS (SELECT mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id, mv.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id ORDER BY mv.period_end DESC NULLS LAST) AS period_rank FROM hq.measure_values AS mv JOIN tx_hospitals AS tx ON tx.facility_id = mv.facility_id), scored_counts AS (SELECT measure_id, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE score IS NOT NULL) AS BIGINT) AS hospitals_with_score FROM ranked_values WHERE period_rank = 1 GROUP BY measure_id), measure_counts AS (SELECT m.measure_id, m.domain, m.measure_name, CAST(COALESCE(sc.hospitals_with_score, 0) AS BIGINT) AS hospitals_with_score, tx.total_hospitals FROM hq.measures AS m CROSS JOIN total_tx AS tx LEFT JOIN scored_counts AS sc ON sc.measure_id = m.measure_id) SELECT measure_id, domain, measure_name, hospitals_with_score, total_hospitals, ROUND((CAST((total_hospitals - hospitals_with_score) AS DECIMAL) / total_hospitals) * 100, 2) AS percent_missing FROM measure_counts WHERE 2 * (total_hospitals - hospitals_with_score) > total_hospitals ORDER BY percent_missing DESC, measure_id LIMIT 200

SELECT hospital_ownership, measure_id, measure_name, COUNT(DISTINCT facility_id) AS hospital_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(score) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_would_definitely_recommend_pct, ROUND(CAST(AVG(overall_rating) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_overall_star_rating FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY' AND score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hospital_ownership, measure_id, measure_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT facility_id) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_would_definitely_recommend_pct DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT county, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY score ASC) AS rank, facility_name AS hospital, score AS rate, measure_id, measure_name FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE is_houston_area IS TRUE AND measure_id = 'READM_30_HF' ORDER BY county, rank, hospital LIMIT 200

SELECT facility_name, county, measure_id, measure_name, score, ROUND(CAST(AVG(score) OVER () AS DECIMAL), 2) AS texas_average, ROUND(CAST((score - AVG(score) OVER ()) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS difference_from_texas_average, ROUND(CAST(AVG(score) OVER (PARTITION BY county) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS county_average FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' AND score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_texas_average ASC, facility_name LIMIT 200

SELECT facility_name, measure_id, measure_name, score, national_pct_rank FROM hq.v_benchmarks WHERE measure_id = 'MORT_30_HF' AND is_houston_area = TRUE AND score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY national_pct_rank LIMIT 200

WITH periods AS (
    SELECT
        h.facility_name,
        mv.measure_id,
        mv.measure_name,
        mv.score,
        mv.period_start,
        mv.period_end,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id
            ORDER BY mv.period_end DESC, mv.period_start DESC
        ) AS period_rank
    FROM hq.measure_values AS mv
    JOIN hq.hospitals AS h
      ON h.facility_id = mv.facility_id
    WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE
      AND mv.measure_id = 'H_HSP_RATING_9_10'
      AND mv.score IS NOT NULL
), changes AS (
    SELECT
        current.facility_name,
        current.measure_id,
        current.measure_name,
        current.score AS current_score,
        prior.score AS prior_score,
        current.score - prior.score AS change,
        current.period_start AS current_period_start,
        current.period_end AS current_period_end,
        prior.period_start AS prior_period_start,
        prior.period_end AS prior_period_end
    FROM periods AS current
    JOIN periods AS prior
      ON prior.facility_name = current.facility_name
     AND prior.measure_id = current.measure_id
     AND prior.period_rank = 2
    WHERE current.period_rank = 1
), improvements AS (
    SELECT
        changes.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY change DESC) AS rank,
        1 AS section_order,
        'Improvement' AS change_type
    FROM changes
    WHERE change > 0
), declines AS (
    SELECT
        changes.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY change ASC) AS rank,
        2 AS section_order,
        'Decline' AS change_type
    FROM changes
    WHERE change < 0
), selected AS (
    SELECT * FROM improvements WHERE rank <= 10
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM declines WHERE rank <= 10
)
SELECT
    facility_name,
    measure_id,
    measure_name,
    change_type,
    ROUND(change::numeric, 2) AS change_percentage_points,
    current_score,
    prior_score,
    current_period_start,
    current_period_end,
    prior_period_start,
    prior_period_end
FROM selected
ORDER BY section_order, rank

WITH hospital_metrics AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS readm_30_pn_rate, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS definitely_recommend_pct, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'SEP_1') AS sepsis_bundle_pct FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'H_RECMND_DY', 'SEP_1') GROUP BY facility_id, facility_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT measure_id) = 3), complete_metrics AS (SELECT * FROM hospital_metrics WHERE readm_30_pn_rate IS NOT NULL AND definitely_recommend_pct IS NOT NULL AND sepsis_bundle_pct IS NOT NULL), metric_stats AS (SELECT AVG(readm_30_pn_rate) AS readm_avg, STDDEV(readm_30_pn_rate) AS readm_sd, AVG(definitely_recommend_pct) AS recommend_avg, STDDEV(definitely_recommend_pct) AS recommend_sd, AVG(sepsis_bundle_pct) AS sepsis_avg, STDDEV(sepsis_bundle_pct) AS sepsis_sd FROM complete_metrics), scored AS (SELECT m.facility_id, m.facility_name, ROUND(CAST(((s.readm_avg - m.readm_30_pn_rate) / NULLIF(s.readm_sd, 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS readm_30_pn_z, ROUND(CAST(((m.definitely_recommend_pct - s.recommend_avg) / NULLIF(s.recommend_sd, 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS definitely_recommend_z, ROUND(CAST(((m.sepsis_bundle_pct - s.sepsis_avg) / NULLIF(s.sepsis_sd, 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS sepsis_bundle_z, ROUND(CAST((((s.readm_avg - m.readm_30_pn_rate) / NULLIF(s.readm_sd, 0)) + ((m.definitely_recommend_pct - s.recommend_avg) / NULLIF(s.recommend_sd, 0)) + ((m.sepsis_bundle_pct - s.sepsis_avg) / NULLIF(s.sepsis_sd, 0))) AS DECIMAL) / 3, 2) AS composite_z FROM complete_metrics AS m CROSS JOIN metric_stats AS s), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite_z DESC, facility_name) AS top_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite_z ASC, facility_name) AS bottom_rank FROM scored) SELECT 'Top 10' AS group_label, top_rank AS rank, facility_id, facility_name, readm_30_pn_z, definitely_recommend_z, sepsis_bundle_z, composite_z FROM ranked WHERE top_rank <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'Bottom 10' AS group_label, bottom_rank AS rank, facility_id, facility_name, readm_30_pn_z, definitely_recommend_z, sepsis_bundle_z, composite_z FROM ranked WHERE bottom_rank <= 10 ORDER BY group_label DESC, rank LIMIT 200

WITH texas AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, county, measure_id, measure_name, score FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'H_RECMND_DY') AND score IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT measure_id, AVG(score) AS avg_score FROM texas GROUP BY measure_id), hospital_scores AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, county, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS readm_pn_score, MAX(measure_name) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS readm_pn_name, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS recommend_score, MAX(measure_name) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS recommend_name FROM texas GROUP BY facility_id, facility_name, county) SELECT h.facility_name AS hospital, h.county, 'READM_30_PN' AS readmission_measure_id, h.readm_pn_name AS readmission_measure, h.readm_pn_score AS readmission_score, ROUND(CAST(readm_avg.avg_score AS DECIMAL), 2) AS texas_readmission_average, 'H_RECMND_DY' AS recommendation_measure_id, h.recommend_name AS recommendation_measure, h.recommend_score AS recommendation_score, ROUND(CAST(recommend_avg.avg_score AS DECIMAL), 2) AS texas_recommendation_average FROM hospital_scores AS h JOIN averages AS readm_avg ON readm_avg.measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' JOIN averages AS recommend_avg ON recommend_avg.measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY' WHERE h.readm_pn_score IS NOT NULL AND h.recommend_score IS NOT NULL AND h.readm_pn_score < readm_avg.avg_score AND h.recommend_score < recommend_avg.avg_score ORDER BY h.readm_pn_score ASC, h.facility_name LIMIT 200

SELECT h.county, COUNT(DISTINCT h.facility_id) AS hospital_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.facility_id) AS hospitals_with_score, CAST('READM_30_PN' AS TEXT) AS measure_id, MAX(v.measure_name) AS measure_name, ROUND(CAST(AVG(v.score) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS simple_mean_readmission_score, ROUND(CAST((SUM(v.score * v.denominator) / NULLIF(SUM(v.denominator), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS denominator_weighted_mean_readmission_score FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN hq.v_tx_latest AS v ON v.facility_id = h.facility_id AND v.measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE GROUP BY h.county ORDER BY denominator_weighted_mean_readmission_score ASC, h.county LIMIT 200

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id) mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id, mv.score FROM hq.measure_values AS mv JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = mv.facility_id WHERE mv.measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'MORT_30_HF', 'HAI_1_SIR', 'SEP_1', 'H_RECMND_DY', 'H_STAR_RATING') ORDER BY mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id, mv.period_end DESC NULLS LAST, mv.id DESC), scored AS (SELECT l.facility_id, l.measure_id, l.score, h.is_texas FROM latest AS l JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = l.facility_id WHERE l.score IS NOT NULL), national AS (SELECT measure_id, AVG(score) AS national_avg FROM scored GROUP BY measure_id), texas AS (SELECT s.measure_id, COUNT(*) AS texas_hospitals, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE (m.higher_is_better AND s.score > n.national_avg) OR (m.higher_is_better = FALSE AND s.score < n.national_avg)) AS beating_national FROM scored AS s JOIN national AS n ON n.measure_id = s.measure_id JOIN hq.measures AS m ON m.measure_id = s.measure_id WHERE s.is_texas GROUP BY s.measure_id) SELECT m.measure_id, m.measure_name, COALESCE(t.texas_hospitals, 0) AS texas_hospitals, COALESCE(t.beating_national, 0) AS beating_national, ROUND(100.0 * CAST(t.beating_national AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(t.texas_hospitals, 0), 2) AS share_beating_national_pct FROM hq.measures AS m LEFT JOIN texas AS t ON t.measure_id = m.measure_id WHERE m.measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'MORT_30_HF', 'HAI_1_SIR', 'SEP_1', 'H_RECMND_DY', 'H_STAR_RATING') ORDER BY m.measure_name LIMIT 200

WITH latest_pneumonia_readmission AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (mv.facility_id) mv.facility_id, mv.score FROM hq.measure_values AS mv WHERE mv.measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' ORDER BY mv.facility_id, mv.period_end DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT h.facility_name, h.county, h.hospital_ownership, h.overall_rating AS overall_star_rating, lpr.score AS pneumonia_30_day_readmission_rate FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN latest_pneumonia_readmission AS lpr ON lpr.facility_id = h.facility_id WHERE h.is_houston_area = TRUE ORDER BY lpr.score ASC, h.facility_name LIMIT 200

WITH tx_total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_hospitals FROM hq.hospitals WHERE is_texas), scored AS (SELECT measure_id, COUNT(DISTINCT facility_id) AS hospitals_with_score FROM hq.v_tx_latest GROUP BY measure_id) SELECT m.measure_id, m.domain, m.measure_name, COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0) AS hospitals_with_score, t.total_hospitals, ROUND(CAST((100.0 * (t.total_hospitals - COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0)) / t.total_hospitals) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS percent_missing FROM hq.measures AS m CROSS JOIN tx_total AS t LEFT JOIN scored AS s ON s.measure_id = m.measure_id WHERE 2 * (t.total_hospitals - COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0)) > t.total_hospitals ORDER BY (t.total_hospitals - COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0)) DESC, m.measure_name LIMIT 200

SELECT h.hospital_ownership, COUNT(*) AS hospital_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(hc.top_box_pct) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_would_definitely_recommend_pct, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.overall_rating) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_overall_star_rating FROM hq.hospitals AS h JOIN hq.v_hcahps AS hc ON hc.facility_id = h.facility_id AND hc.measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY' WHERE h.is_texas GROUP BY h.hospital_ownership HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY AVG(hc.top_box_pct) DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT county, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY score ASC) AS rank, facility_name AS hospital, score AS heart_failure_30_day_readmission_rate, measure_id, measure_name FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE is_houston_area = TRUE AND measure_id = 'READM_30_HF' AND score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY county, rank, hospital LIMIT 200

WITH pneumonia AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, county, measure_id, measure_name, score FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' AND score IS NOT NULL) SELECT facility_name, county, measure_id, measure_name, score, ROUND(CAST(AVG(score) OVER () AS DECIMAL), 2) AS texas_average, ROUND(CAST((score - AVG(score) OVER ()) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS difference_from_texas_average, ROUND(CAST(AVG(score) OVER (PARTITION BY county) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS county_average FROM pneumonia ORDER BY difference_from_texas_average ASC, facility_name LIMIT 200

SELECT facility_name, measure_name, ROUND(CAST(national_pct_rank AS DECIMAL), 2) AS national_percentile, score AS heart_failure_30_day_mortality_rate FROM hq.v_benchmarks WHERE measure_id = 'MORT_30_HF' AND is_houston_area = TRUE AND score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY national_pct_rank ASC, facility_name LIMIT 200

WITH ranked_periods AS (
    SELECT
        h.facility_id,
        h.facility_name,
        mv.measure_id,
        mv.measure_name,
        mv.score,
        mv.period_start,
        mv.period_end,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY h.facility_id, mv.measure_id
            ORDER BY mv.period_end DESC, mv.period_start DESC
        ) AS period_rank
    FROM hq.measure_values AS mv
    JOIN hq.hospitals AS h
      ON h.facility_id = mv.facility_id
    WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE
      AND mv.measure_id = 'H_HSP_RATING_9_10'
      AND mv.score IS NOT NULL
), changes AS (
    SELECT
        current.facility_id,
        current.facility_name,
        current.measure_id,
        current.measure_name,
        prior.period_start AS prior_period_start,
        prior.period_end AS prior_period_end,
        prior.score AS prior_score,
        current.period_start AS current_period_start,
        current.period_end AS current_period_end,
        current.score AS current_score,
        current.score - prior.score AS change
    FROM ranked_periods AS current
    JOIN ranked_periods AS prior
      ON prior.facility_id = current.facility_id
     AND prior.measure_id = current.measure_id
     AND prior.period_rank = 2
    WHERE current.period_rank = 1
), ranked_changes AS (
    SELECT
        changes.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY change DESC, facility_name) AS improvement_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY change ASC, facility_name) AS decline_rank
    FROM changes
), selected AS (
    SELECT
        'Biggest improvements' AS change_group,
        improvement_rank AS rank,
        facility_id,
        facility_name,
        measure_id,
        measure_name,
        prior_period_start,
        prior_period_end,
        prior_score,
        current_period_start,
        current_period_end,
        current_score,
        ROUND(change::numeric, 2) AS change_percentage_points
    FROM ranked_changes
    WHERE change > 0
      AND improvement_rank <= 10

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Biggest declines' AS change_group,
        decline_rank AS rank,
        facility_id,
        facility_name,
        measure_id,
        measure_name,
        prior_period_start,
        prior_period_end,
        prior_score,
        current_period_start,
        current_period_end,
        current_score,
        ROUND(change::numeric, 2) AS change_percentage_points
    FROM ranked_changes
    WHERE change < 0
      AND decline_rank <= 10
)
SELECT *
FROM selected
ORDER BY CASE change_group WHEN 'Biggest improvements' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, rank;

WITH hospital_scores AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS pneumonia_readmission_rate, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS definitely_recommend_pct, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'SEP_1') AS sepsis_bundle_pct FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'H_RECMND_DY', 'SEP_1') AND score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY facility_id, facility_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT measure_id) = 3), stats AS (SELECT AVG(pneumonia_readmission_rate) AS readm_avg, STDDEV(pneumonia_readmission_rate) AS readm_sd, AVG(definitely_recommend_pct) AS recommend_avg, STDDEV(definitely_recommend_pct) AS recommend_sd, AVG(sepsis_bundle_pct) AS sepsis_avg, STDDEV(sepsis_bundle_pct) AS sepsis_sd FROM hospital_scores), z_scores AS (SELECT h.facility_id, h.facility_name, (s.readm_avg - h.pneumonia_readmission_rate) / NULLIF(s.readm_sd, 0) AS readmission_z, (h.definitely_recommend_pct - s.recommend_avg) / NULLIF(s.recommend_sd, 0) AS recommend_z, (h.sepsis_bundle_pct - s.sepsis_avg) / NULLIF(s.sepsis_sd, 0) AS sepsis_z FROM hospital_scores AS h CROSS JOIN stats AS s), composites AS (SELECT *, (readmission_z + recommend_z + sepsis_z) / 3.0 AS composite_score FROM z_scores), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite_score DESC, facility_name) AS top_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite_score ASC, facility_name) AS bottom_rank FROM composites) SELECT CASE WHEN top_rank <= 10 THEN 'Top 10' ELSE 'Bottom 10' END AS group_name, CASE WHEN top_rank <= 10 THEN top_rank ELSE bottom_rank END AS rank, facility_name, 'READM_30_PN' AS readmission_measure_id, 'Pneumonia (PN) 30-Day Readmission Rate' AS readmission_measure_name, ROUND(readmission_z, 2) AS readmission_z_flipped, 'H_RECMND_DY' AS recommend_measure_id, 'Patients who reported YES, they would definitely recommend the hospital' AS recommend_measure_name, ROUND(recommend_z, 2) AS definitely_recommend_z, 'SEP_1' AS sepsis_measure_id, 'Appropriate care for severe sepsis and septic shock' AS sepsis_measure_name, ROUND(sepsis_z, 2) AS sepsis_bundle_z, ROUND(composite_score, 2) AS composite_score FROM ranked WHERE top_rank <= 10 OR bottom_rank <= 10 ORDER BY CASE WHEN top_rank <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CASE WHEN top_rank <= 10 THEN top_rank ELSE bottom_rank END LIMIT 200

WITH tx AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, county, measure_id, measure_name, score FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'H_RECMND_DY')), averages AS (SELECT AVG(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS pneumonia_tx_average, AVG(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS recommend_tx_average FROM tx), hospitals AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, county, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS pneumonia_readmission_rate, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS definitely_recommend_pct FROM tx GROUP BY facility_id, facility_name, county HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT measure_id) = 2) SELECT h.facility_name AS hospital, h.county, 'READM_30_PN' AS pneumonia_measure_id, 'Pneumonia (PN) 30-Day Readmission Rate' AS pneumonia_measure_name, h.pneumonia_readmission_rate, a.pneumonia_tx_average, 'H_RECMND_DY' AS recommend_measure_id, 'Patients who reported YES, they would definitely recommend the hospital' AS recommend_measure_name, h.definitely_recommend_pct, a.recommend_tx_average FROM hospitals AS h CROSS JOIN averages AS a WHERE h.pneumonia_readmission_rate < a.pneumonia_tx_average AND h.definitely_recommend_pct < a.recommend_tx_average ORDER BY h.facility_name LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT h.county, COUNT(DISTINCT h.facility_id) AS hospital_count, COUNT(v.score) AS hospitals_with_pneumonia_readmission_score, ROUND(CAST(AVG(v.score) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS simple_mean_readmission_score, ROUND(CAST((SUM(v.score * v.denominator) / NULLIF(SUM(v.denominator), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS denominator_weighted_mean_readmission_score FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN hq.v_tx_latest AS v ON v.facility_id = h.facility_id AND v.measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE GROUP BY h.county ORDER BY denominator_weighted_mean_readmission_score ASC, h.county LIMIT 200

SELECT facility_name, city, readm_pn_pct AS pneumonia_readmission_rate_pct, mort_hf_pct AS heart_failure_mortality_rate_pct, hai_clabsi_sir AS central_line_infection_ratio, sepsis_bundle_pct AS sepsis_care_bundle_pct, recommend_pct AS would_recommend_pct, hcahps_star AS hcahps_summary_star_rating FROM hq.v_scorecard WHERE is_houston_area = TRUE ORDER BY recommend_pct DESC NULLS LAST, facility_name LIMIT 200

WITH targets(measure_id, sort_order) AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('READM_30_PN', 1), ('MORT_30_HF', 2), ('HAI_1_SIR', 3), ('SEP_1', 4), ('H_RECMND_DY', 5), ('H_STAR_RATING', 6)) AS _values), latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id) mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id, mv.score FROM hq.measure_values AS mv JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = mv.facility_id JOIN targets AS t ON t.measure_id = mv.measure_id WHERE mv.score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id, mv.period_end DESC NULLS LAST), national AS (SELECT l.measure_id, AVG(l.score) AS national_avg FROM latest AS l GROUP BY l.measure_id) SELECT m.measure_id, m.measure_name, COUNT(*) AS texas_hospitals, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE (m.higher_is_better AND l.score > n.national_avg) OR (NOT m.higher_is_better AND l.score < n.national_avg)) AS texas_hospitals_beating_national, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE (m.higher_is_better AND l.score > n.national_avg) OR (NOT m.higher_is_better AND l.score < n.national_avg)) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS share_beating_national_pct FROM targets AS t JOIN hq.measures AS m ON m.measure_id = t.measure_id JOIN latest AS l ON l.measure_id = t.measure_id JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = l.facility_id AND h.is_texas JOIN national AS n ON n.measure_id = t.measure_id GROUP BY t.sort_order, m.measure_id, m.measure_name, m.higher_is_better ORDER BY t.sort_order LIMIT 200

WITH latest AS (SELECT mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id, mv.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id ORDER BY mv.period_end DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM hq.measure_values AS mv WHERE mv.measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') SELECT h.facility_name, h.county, h.hospital_ownership, h.overall_rating AS overall_star_rating, m.measure_id, m.measure_name, l.score AS latest_readmission_rate FROM hq.hospitals AS h CROSS JOIN hq.measures AS m LEFT JOIN latest AS l ON l.facility_id = h.facility_id AND l.measure_id = m.measure_id AND l.rn = 1 WHERE h.is_houston_area = TRUE AND m.measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' ORDER BY l.score ASC, h.facility_name LIMIT 200

WITH tx_total AS (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL) AS total_hospitals FROM hq.hospitals WHERE is_texas = TRUE), scored AS (SELECT measure_id, COUNT(DISTINCT facility_id) AS hospitals_with_score FROM hq.v_tx_latest GROUP BY measure_id) SELECT m.measure_id, m.domain, m.measure_name, COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0) AS hospitals_with_score, t.total_hospitals AS total_texas_hospitals, ROUND(CAST(((t.total_hospitals - COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0)) / t.total_hospitals * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS percent_missing FROM hq.measures AS m CROSS JOIN tx_total AS t LEFT JOIN scored AS s ON s.measure_id = m.measure_id WHERE (t.total_hospitals - COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0)) / t.total_hospitals > 0.5 ORDER BY percent_missing DESC, m.measure_id LIMIT 200

SELECT h.hospital_ownership, COUNT(*) AS hospital_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(t.score) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_would_definitely_recommend_pct, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.overall_rating) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_overall_star_rating FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN hq.v_tx_latest AS t ON t.facility_id = h.facility_id AND t.measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY' WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE AND h.hospital_ownership IS NOT NULL GROUP BY h.hospital_ownership HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY AVG(t.score) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

WITH pneumonia AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, county, score FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' AND score IS NOT NULL) SELECT facility_name, county, score, ROUND(CAST(AVG(score) OVER () AS DECIMAL), 2) AS texas_average, ROUND(CAST((score - AVG(score) OVER ()) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS difference_from_texas_average, ROUND(CAST(AVG(score) OVER (PARTITION BY county) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS county_average FROM pneumonia ORDER BY difference_from_texas_average ASC, facility_name LIMIT 200

SELECT facility_name, measure_id, measure_name, score, national_pct_rank FROM hq.v_benchmarks WHERE measure_id = 'MORT_30_HF' AND is_houston_area IS TRUE ORDER BY national_pct_rank ASC, facility_name LIMIT 200

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    mv.facility_id,
    h.facility_name,
    mv.period_end,
    mv.score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY mv.facility_id
      ORDER BY mv.period_end DESC
    ) AS period_rank
  FROM hq.measure_values AS mv
  JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = mv.facility_id
  WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE
    AND mv.measure_id = 'H_HSP_RATING_9_10'
    AND mv.score IS NOT NULL
), changes AS (
  SELECT
    current.facility_id,
    current.facility_name,
    prior.period_end AS prior_period_end,
    current.period_end AS current_period_end,
    prior.score AS prior_score,
    current.score AS current_score,
    current.score - prior.score AS change
  FROM ranked AS current
  JOIN ranked AS prior
    ON prior.facility_id = current.facility_id
   AND prior.period_rank = 2
  WHERE current.period_rank = 1
), improvements AS (
  SELECT 'Improvement' AS change_type, facility_name, prior_period_end, current_period_end,
         prior_score, current_score, ROUND(change::numeric, 2) AS change
  FROM changes
  ORDER BY change DESC
  LIMIT 10
), declines AS (
  SELECT 'Decline' AS change_type, facility_name, prior_period_end, current_period_end,
         prior_score, current_score, ROUND(change::numeric, 2) AS change
  FROM changes
  ORDER BY change ASC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT change_type, facility_name, prior_period_end, current_period_end,
       prior_score, current_score, change
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM improvements
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM declines
) AS results
ORDER BY CASE change_type WHEN 'Improvement' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
         CASE WHEN change_type = 'Improvement' THEN change END DESC,
         CASE WHEN change_type = 'Decline' THEN change END ASC

WITH hospital_scores AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS pn_readmission, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS definitely_recommend, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'SEP_1') AS sepsis_bundle FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'H_RECMND_DY', 'SEP_1') AND score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY facility_id, facility_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT measure_id) = 3), measure_stats AS (SELECT AVG(pn_readmission) AS pn_mean, STDDEV(pn_readmission) AS pn_sd, AVG(definitely_recommend) AS recommend_mean, STDDEV(definitely_recommend) AS recommend_sd, AVG(sepsis_bundle) AS sepsis_mean, STDDEV(sepsis_bundle) AS sepsis_sd FROM hospital_scores), scored AS (SELECT h.facility_name, (s.pn_mean - h.pn_readmission) / NULLIF(s.pn_sd, 0) AS pn_readmission_z, (h.definitely_recommend - s.recommend_mean) / NULLIF(s.recommend_sd, 0) AS definitely_recommend_z, (h.sepsis_bundle - s.sepsis_mean) / NULLIF(s.sepsis_sd, 0) AS sepsis_bundle_z FROM hospital_scores AS h CROSS JOIN measure_stats AS s), composites AS (SELECT facility_name, pn_readmission_z, definitely_recommend_z, sepsis_bundle_z, (pn_readmission_z + definitely_recommend_z + sepsis_bundle_z) / 3.0 AS composite_z FROM scored), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite_z DESC, facility_name) AS top_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite_z ASC, facility_name) AS bottom_rank FROM composites), selected AS (SELECT 1 AS section_order, top_rank AS rank, facility_name, pn_readmission_z, definitely_recommend_z, sepsis_bundle_z, composite_z FROM ranked WHERE top_rank <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS section_order, bottom_rank AS rank, facility_name, pn_readmission_z, definitely_recommend_z, sepsis_bundle_z, composite_z FROM ranked WHERE bottom_rank <= 10) SELECT CASE WHEN section_order = 1 THEN 'Top 10' ELSE 'Bottom 10' END AS group_name, rank, facility_name, ROUND(CAST(pn_readmission_z AS DECIMAL), 2) AS pneumonia_readmission_z, ROUND(CAST(definitely_recommend_z AS DECIMAL), 2) AS definitely_recommend_z, ROUND(CAST(sepsis_bundle_z AS DECIMAL), 2) AS sepsis_bundle_z, ROUND(CAST(composite_z AS DECIMAL), 2) AS composite_z FROM selected ORDER BY section_order, rank LIMIT 200

WITH tx_scores AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, county, measure_id, score FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'H_RECMND_DY') AND score IS NOT NULL), tx_averages AS (SELECT measure_id, AVG(score) AS texas_average FROM tx_scores GROUP BY measure_id), hospital_scores AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, county, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS pneumonia_readmission_rate, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS definitely_recommend_pct FROM tx_scores GROUP BY facility_id, facility_name, county) SELECT hs.facility_name AS hospital, hs.county, hs.pneumonia_readmission_rate, ROUND(CAST(readm_avg.texas_average AS DECIMAL), 2) AS texas_avg_pneumonia_readmission_rate, hs.definitely_recommend_pct, ROUND(CAST(recommend_avg.texas_average AS DECIMAL), 2) AS texas_avg_definitely_recommend_pct FROM hospital_scores AS hs JOIN tx_averages AS readm_avg ON readm_avg.measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' JOIN tx_averages AS recommend_avg ON recommend_avg.measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY' WHERE hs.pneumonia_readmission_rate < readm_avg.texas_average AND hs.definitely_recommend_pct < recommend_avg.texas_average AND hs.pneumonia_readmission_rate IS NOT NULL AND hs.definitely_recommend_pct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY hs.facility_name LIMIT 200

SELECT h.county AS county, COUNT(DISTINCT h.facility_id) AS hospital_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.facility_id) FILTER(WHERE t.score IS NOT NULL) AS hospitals_with_readmission_score, ROUND(CAST(AVG(t.score) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS mean_readmission_score, ROUND(CAST((SUM(t.score * t.denominator) FILTER(WHERE t.score IS NOT NULL AND t.denominator IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(SUM(t.denominator) FILTER(WHERE t.score IS NOT NULL AND t.denominator IS NOT NULL), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS denominator_weighted_mean_readmission_score FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN hq.v_tx_latest AS t ON t.facility_id = h.facility_id AND t.measure_id = 'READM_30_PN' WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE GROUP BY h.county ORDER BY denominator_weighted_mean_readmission_score ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT facility_name, readm_pn_pct, 'READM_30_PN' AS readm_pn_measure_id, 'Pneumonia (PN) 30-Day Readmission Rate' AS readm_pn_measure_name, mort_hf_pct, 'MORT_30_HF' AS mort_hf_measure_id, 'Death rate for heart failure patients' AS mort_hf_measure_name, hai_clabsi_sir, 'HAI_1_SIR' AS clabsi_measure_id, 'Central Line Associated Bloodstream Infection (ICU + select Wards)' AS clabsi_measure_name, sepsis_bundle_pct, 'SEP_1' AS sepsis_bundle_measure_id, 'Appropriate care for severe sepsis and septic shock' AS sepsis_bundle_measure_name, recommend_pct, 'H_RECMND_DY' AS recommend_measure_id, 'Patients who reported YES, they would definitely recommend the hospital' AS recommend_measure_name, hcahps_star, 'H_STAR_RATING' AS hcahps_star_measure_id, 'Summary star rating' AS hcahps_star_measure_name FROM hq.v_scorecard WHERE is_houston_area IS TRUE ORDER BY recommend_pct DESC NULLS LAST, facility_name LIMIT 200

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id) mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id, mv.score FROM hq.measure_values AS mv WHERE mv.measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'MORT_30_HF', 'HAI_1_SIR', 'SEP_1', 'H_RECMND_DY', 'H_STAR_RATING') AND mv.score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id, mv.period_end DESC NULLS LAST), national AS (SELECT l.measure_id, AVG(l.score) AS national_avg FROM latest AS l GROUP BY l.measure_id), texas AS (SELECT l.measure_id, m.measure_name, m.higher_is_better, COUNT(*) AS texas_hospitals, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE (m.higher_is_better AND l.score > n.national_avg) OR (NOT m.higher_is_better AND l.score < n.national_avg)) AS beating_national FROM latest AS l JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = l.facility_id JOIN hq.measures AS m ON m.measure_id = l.measure_id JOIN national AS n ON n.measure_id = l.measure_id WHERE h.is_texas GROUP BY l.measure_id, m.measure_name, m.higher_is_better) SELECT measure_id, measure_name, texas_hospitals, beating_national, ROUND(100.0 * beating_national / NULLIF(texas_hospitals, 0), 2) AS share_beating_national_pct FROM texas ORDER BY measure_id LIMIT 200
